title: Type conversion chain
description: Chains multiple type conversions through CInt, CLng, CDbl, CStr, CBool, Val, and Str functions. Prints the value and type name at each step to trace the conversion pipeline.

modules.description: Type conversion chain demonstrating CInt, CLng, CDbl, CStr, CBool, Val, Str

provenance_detail: Clean-room authored to exercise type coercion functions of VBA built-in library
